人物场景超可控灯光（人物/角色/场景/融合/校色/手动可控打光拒绝无效灯光）V1.0

PS：分为三个模块，请注意配合或单独使用！！！
此套工作流对于没有处理好预先融合的图片，类似人物和场景未融合，还未校色的图片，可以先跑一或者二的工作流，如果预先调整好底图的话可直接跑第三个手动可控灯光


一.场景角色初步融合
1.预先处理图片和场景的融合，可按照人物尺寸为主或者按照场景的尺寸为主，先进行初步的融合，

！！！注意：最终出图为两张，可以手动保存，再进入第三步，或者测试好后触发底下"角色尺寸OR场景尺寸"节点，ture为按照角色尺寸来，


二.图片参考校色
1.预先处理图片场景角色确认后，但是颜色色调与目标图像不太一致，可以进行此工作流，再进行下一步第三工作流进行打光


三.手动超可控灯光
1.输入需要打光的图片，注意只能三选一图片，看需不需要第一步或者第二布的图片预处理的图片，进行连接节点，

2.灯光蒙版有三种办法输入，第一种自己PS黑白蒙版灯光图，第二种用Comfyui自带右键蒙版工具绘制蒙版图，注意绘画好需要节点接上！！！第三种可以输入原图，右键有个内嵌式的PS，可以进行PS内一样的操作绘制蒙版



Character scene super controllable lighting (character/scene/fusion/color correction/manually controllable lighting to reject invalid lighting) V1.0

PS: Divided into three modules, please pay attention to using them together or separately!!!
For images that have not been pre fused properly, such as people and scenes that have not been fused or color corrected, this workflow can first run the first or second workflow. If the base image is pre adjusted, the third manually controllable lighting can be run directly

I Initial integration of scene characters
1. Preprocess the fusion of images and scenes, which can be based on the size of the characters or the size of the scene, and perform preliminary fusion first,
！！！ Note: The final output consists of two images, which can be manually saved before entering the third step, or after testing, the "Character Size OR Scene Size" node can be triggered below, where "ture" is based on the character size,

II Image reference color correction
1. After confirming the scene characters in the pre-processing image, but the color tone is not consistent with the target image, this workflow can be carried out, and then the next step is the third workflow for lighting

III Manual ultra controllable lighting
1. Enter the image that needs to be illuminated, note that only one image can be selected from three options. Check whether the image preprocessing for the first or second step is required, and connect the nodes accordingly,

2.There are three ways to input a light mask: the first is to use your own PS black and white mask light map, and the second is to use Comfyui's built-in right-click mask tool to draw the mask map. Be sure to connect the nodes after drawing!!! The third option is to input the original image and right-click on an embedded PS, where you can perform the same operations as in PS to draw masks
